description: Ironflow's own uptime over the last 24 hours (default) or 7 days: points over the period, each with the service status and how fresh the data was in seconds, plus the overall uptime percent. Use it to check whether a gap or odd value in other results came from an Ironflow outage. For the status right now use get_status; for API latency and error rates use get_status_metrics.
name: get_status_history

notice.description: A note from the API: how a market name was read, why data starts later than asked, or a next step such as a free key

title: API uptime history
